production_use: Historical increment only. Consume complete frozen abi_gu_only.json for implementation.
model_semantics: Keep all 32 Down projections on Host with existing format05 integer arithmetic and original validated weight bytes; remove only FPGA Down implementation.

rejected_opcodes.action: admission rejection: no DMA, compute, metadata fetch, cache owner or completion; preserve active/DONE and first ADMISSION_ERROR
rejected_opcodes.higher_priority_rejections: Preserve fault/maintenance/busy/unacked-DONE priority before opcode validation; BAD_OPCODE applies when healthy admission reaches opcode validation.

zero_only_policy: Apply WSTRB merge; any effective nonzero value returns SLVERR without side effects. Reads always zero. Other action/RO policies inherit base.

metadata.commit: valid GU count and bank/generation checks only; preserve inactive-bank load and commit/drain guards; no Down completion wait

padding_check.host: strict original artifact validation; bytes28..31 must be zero
padding_check.hardware: GU-only loader must validate beat[255:224]==0, not truncate silently
padding_check.effect: Apply metadata_fault_policy; do not confuse no-active-job no-DONE rule with failure completion owed to an accepted GU owner.

invalidation: active metadata bank or generation changed
epoch.preconditions: inherit base for GU-only physical paths and valid GU metadata; Down base words must be zero
epoch.fpga_weight_lease_release: both cohort GU completions successful, identity-matched ACK, physical paths drained and GU output copied to Host-owned buffers
epoch.host_down_lease: independent immutable layer-specific Down artifact handle and GU/activation buffers remain owned until CPU Down/residual consumers finish

clear_fault_completion: Inherit base first-error, fatal upgrade, transport drain, immutable unacked DONE, admission preservation, ACK/epoch and Attention isolation rules; remove nonexistent Down predicates only.

host_down.preprocess: frozen SiLU ROM + exact multiply + wide H32 + checked S35 minmax A8/ScaleCode, once
host_down.shift: sum two u6 shifts in u7; nonzero in [12,44]; signed arithmetic right shift or left shift to F24; checked S45
host_down.accumulate: sum group0..447 in exact int64/Python integer; enforce S54 bounds, no intermediate saturation
host_down.finalize: half-away-from-zero right shift by 8 then saturate S32/F16; same 16x4096 boundary as current FPGA DOWN
host_down.zero_path: zero code contributes zero; retain canonical and metadata/padding validation
host_down.scalar_oracle_scope: bounded output columns with all448groups and boundary cases; do not run full0.94G MAC scalar Python for every regression
host_down.full_shape_validation: optimized blocked int64 vs independent efficient integer reference on production outputs and real artifacts; both checked against bounded scalar oracle
host_down.mac_count_scope: Down dot only, per16row cohort perlayer; excludes preprocessing, decoding, scale recovery and movement

known_removed_scope_current_synth.scope: nonoverlapping Down scheduler, 2 S54 accumulators, 2 Down output queues, 2 Down metadata banks

cache.read_contract: full 16-row group response; reject group>=128; no silent timing/throughput change
cache.range_check: Validate full 9bit group <128 before narrowing RAM address to7bits; group128 must not alias0.

kernel_specialization.first_step: remove Down-only instances and interfaces, constant GU mode, preserve validated GU math
kernel_specialization.second_step: dedicated GU guard37 path and queues, remove Down tag/tile/S45-only storage; independent equivalence against base GU required
kernel_specialization.warning: DOWN_MODE_ENABLE=0 in the current lane still declares45bit guard memory and mode/tag paths; prove actual GU37bit specialization
kernel_specialization.guard_alignment: Sign-extend S33 before left shift; arithmetic right shift; preserve S37 overflow and format counters; no per-group rounding.

validation_required: independent scalar Host Down vs optimized implementation, all 448 groups and overflow/rounding edges
production-shape selected hierarchy has no Down accumulator/queue/scheduler/metadata banks/repack
same-phase whole-board resource and SLR/routing/timing/DRC/CDC evidence
real-artifact full-layer and 32-layer Host scheduling/residual integration
full32bit opcode high-bit rejection with original priority
cache group128 no alias; counter can represent128
reserved Down CSR partial/zero WSTRB effective merge rules

implementation_gates.evidence_separation: A staticDownremoval/GU specialization first; B GU control locality only after new bounded resource/connectivity evidence; no repeated blind full implementation

metadata_fault_policy.target_loading_bank: invalidate target bank and prevent commit/activation; stop metadata record commits and drain accepted AXI
metadata_fault_policy.active_bank: inactive-load fault does not directly rewrite active bank bytes, generation or selection
metadata_fault_policy.epoch: invalidate current epoch qualification immediately on metadata fatal; no new admission or commit until controlled recovery
metadata_fault_policy.no_accepted_job: do not manufacture DONE from CSR or stale descriptor
metadata_fault_policy.accepted_active_gu: preserve first error or latch0x2120; create the real owner failure DONE once under original fatal rules; reset_required=1; retain/drain accepted transactions
metadata_fault_policy.existing_unacked_done: preserve valid, identity, first error and all frozen counters; only upgrade reset_required; same-edge fatal rejects ACK
metadata_fault_policy.recovery: existing trusted transport barrier before hard_clear; revoke resident validity and epoch; Host reload/commit valid GU bank and publish a fresh epoch; framing/global_freeze may require core reset
metadata_fault_policy.attention: retain existing shared maintenance/fault protocol; ordinary GU ACK never clears Attention
